row.evidence: Atera's IT department pricing lists Single sign-on (SSO) and Azure AD continuous sync only on Enterprise; its help centre documents technicians being added manually under Admin > Users and security > Technicians and has no SCIM documentation.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none, by absence). IT Department plans: Professional $149, Expert $189, Master $219 per technician/mo billed annually ($169/$229/$269 monthly); Enterprise is Contact sales. SSO (Azure AD or OIDC) is Enterprise-only and needs the technician to already exist with the same email. The Entra ID integration (one-time sync on all plans, continuous sync on Enterprise) creates and updates end users who request support, not licensed technician accounts. The API (included at no extra cost, not in trial) exposes a Contacts (end user) domain but no technician domain; the API reference sits behind the Atera login. MSP pricing exists separately and was not researched.

limitations.text: Technician accounts are added and disabled manually in the admin UI; a technician account cannot be deleted, only disabled.

user_api.notes: The API covers end-user Contacts (plus customers, agents, tickets, etc.); no technician domain is listed. Endpoint paths are on the in-app API documentation page, which needs a login.

scopes: Full access (Read, Write, Delete) or custom per-domain permissions
auth.notes: Tokens expire at most one year after creation; optional IP allow-list.

limitations.text: No API access during the free trial.
The documented API domains include Contacts (end users) but not technicians, so technician accounts cannot be provisioned via the API.

okta.notes: okta.com/integrations/atera/ returned 404; Atera documents Okta only as a generic OIDC provider for SSO.

entra.notes: SSO uses a customer-created Entra app registration (not a gallery app). Atera's own Entra ID sync creates/updates end users (requesters), not technicians; continuous sync is Enterprise-only.

fallbacks.other_sync: Microsoft Entra ID one-way sync of end users (one-time on all plans, continuous on Enterprise)
fallbacks.notes: CSV/bulk import covers sites and end users, not technicians.
